findings.title: Full-domain runs generate no release notes or changelog draft
evidence: CHANGELOG.md has no full-domain entry (see DOC finding)
findings.impact: Ship-ready notes are not part of a run, and pack changes are not guaranteed a changelog entry.
findings.recommendation: Have aggregate emit both drafts and make the pack changelog entry part of the completion checklist.

report: Reviewed release/changelog artifacts for the self-audit.
